message: Today is a day off.
At Setsugekka's invitation, it was decided that we would all go out for a little trip.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hurry, hurry~♪ Where are we going？ Hey, where shall we go! Whoa, ahaha!」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Setsugekka, stop running. Don't go wandering off！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Isn't Secchan, like, super hyper？ Momitchi, what’s up with her？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Beats me... and besides, I’m not Setsugekka’s handler.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, and speaking of that, Momitchi, why are you in your uniform？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because I don’t have any other clothes for going out.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh, is that so...」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, I’m joking. I had some business at the academy, that’s all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Let’s go shopping for clothes together later, Momitchi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I just told you I was joking!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh my, the uniform isn't actually that bad, you know. There are times when the lack of individuality that comes from uniformity is required.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...What’s that supposed to mean？」

name: Momiji
message: 「In short, isn't it that you don’t want to stand out？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You Kazamine sisters really have brains that are just off the charts~」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, I’ll take that as a compliment.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That aside, sensei, we have to do something about her.」
Momiji points at Setsugekka, who is darting back and forth.

name: Iori
message: 「Easy for you to say. Do you think that’s some kind of Tenju runaway effect too？」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, it definitely isn’t.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, perhaps it is the lingering effects of the runaway？ This morning’s incident was quite severe, after all.」
A lot has happened today, starting with Setsugekka barging in early this morning insisting we all go out, and topped off by her losing control during morning practice.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, how about that Italian place Ririmu-chan was talking about before? That sounds good, right, Italian?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Do you even realize we’re talking about you right now？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, but more than that, what are we going to play？ Have we decided where we’re going？」
Just as I thought Setsugekka had finally returned... she wound her arms around mine.
<s34>M-my arm, I feel something soft...！</s>

name: Iori
message: 「Hey... Setsugekka, what are you doing?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka, that’s not fair.」
This time, Asahi wound her arms around my other side.

name: Iori
message: 「A-Asahi, you stop it too!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ll stop when Setsugekka stops.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa~, Sencei, you’ve got girls hanging all over you, how lewd~. It’s a <d0103>harem</d> date, a total harem date.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Teacher, you look pretty giddy about being asked out on a date, don’t ya~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fu-fu-fu, today is a day for no rules~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka, that’s not what ‘no rules’ means.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fu-fu-fu, your arm is so warm, Iori.」

name: Iori
message: 「I-in any case, both of you, let go!」
I managed to get Setsugekka and Asahi to let go.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Phew, what a shame... I think you need to take a break sometimes too, Muragaki.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m fine. Just being here like this is fun enough.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, is that because your target of affection is among us？」

name: Iori
message: 「D-don’t jump to such wild conclusions!」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m a man, after all. Of course I’d be happy being surrounded by such lovely ladies.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...So, Iori, you really do want a harem after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, I didn’t mean anything deep by that!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You’re surrounded by us in the classroom too, right？ I don’t see why today would be any different~」

name: Iori
message: 「There’s a difference between work and private life, you know.」

name: Asahi
message: 「So, does that mean it’s open season to seduce you, Iori？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah—I should warn you, I’m going to say no to anything that’ll get me fired as a teacher.」

name: Asahi
message: 「A sincere relationship would be fine, then!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mmh, so basically, Sensei, are you quitting being a teacher today？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that’s about the size of it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha, now that I think about it, that makes sense, doesn’t it~」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’ve been calling him Iori-san for a while now.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, that’s right. Asahi, why don’t you try calling him Iorin once in a while？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Eh, Iorin... is it? Iorin... hmmm.」
—Come to think of it, the wall that used to be between Ririmu and Asahi seems to have completely vanished.
Seeing them chatting so normally, I feel relieved.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-san, Iorin, which do you think is better? No, I mean, which would you prefer to be called?」

name: Iori
message: 「You can call me whatever you like, Asahi.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then, let’s strike a balance and go with Mura-chan! Mura-chan Sensei! How’s that!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That’s good.」

name: Asahi
message: 「A... balance？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That naming sense is... you aren’t actually serious, are you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Geez~~, you two are such buzzkills！？ Things like this are all about the momentum, the M-O-M-E-N-T-U-M！」
In that fashion, Setsugekka remained in high spirits the entire time.
It was just as we were returning to the original area after wandering around and checking out a few shops while making such a ruckus, that it happened.
Suddenly, Keisetsu pulled out her terminal and stopped in her tracks.

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, is something wrong？」
I called out to Keisetsu, whose expression had changed after checking her terminal.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’m sorry, I have an urgent matter to attend to. I hate to do this, but I’ll have to excuse myself here.」
Ah, work, I see.

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t worry about us. Go on ahead.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehhhhh！ No way, isn’t there anything you can do...？ I guess not, huh？ Haaaauuu...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’m sorry. Setsugekka, you go ahead and enjoy yourself with everyone else.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, I got it. Kei-chan, let’s go out and hang out together again sometime！ It’s a promise！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, all right. Well then, everyone, go have fun.」
With that, Keisetsu turned on her heel and walked away. After watching her go for a moment, we all started walking again.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Good job, Secchan! You didn't act selfish at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course~ I don't wanna get in Kei-chan's way, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Instead, I'm gonna have a blast and tell her all about it later♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's a good idea.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come on, let's head out and find some fun！」
With that, Setsugekka linked her arm through mine and started walking. As I got pulled along after her, I heard Asahi's and Momiji's voices from behind.

name: Asahi
message: 「Mmmmm...」

name: Momiji
message: 「What's up? Why the scary face?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey~ No fair, Secchan！ Stop hogging Iorin all to yourself~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nope, not sharing♪ Today, Sensei and I are just a man and a woman！ Dating is war, Ririmu-chan！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, that's quite right! I won't hold back either!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, you're making that dopey face again, sandwiched between the two of them. Think I'll report this to the academy later~」

name: Asahi
message: 「You say that, Momiji-san, but you really want to cling to Iori-san too, don't you？」

name: Momiji
message: 「A-Are you stupid?! As if I'd ever want to do that!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're such a tsundere, Momicchi~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You really are a tsundere, Momimomi~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I said I'm not~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, you really are popular, Iori-san. Personally, I can't stop worrying that you might cheat on me.」

name: Asahi
message: 「And Momiji-san looks like she's having so much fun, too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even someone as skilled at reading moves ahead as Momiji-san can't see herself, it seems. That's a bit of a relief.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I told you, it's nothing like that!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I officially consider Momiji-san a rival as well. I have absolutely no intention of yielding!」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Oh, really? Fine, whatever—I'm just gonna own it!」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, Momiji too！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, Momimomi’s getting in on it too♪ We’re fighting over Sensei！」
Momiji breaks through the space between Setsugekka and Asahi, who are wrapped around my arms, and clings to my body.

name: Asahi
message: 「Mm... Momiji-san, that’s cheating! I wanted to get a taste of that chest too...!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, early bird gets the worm~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha♪ Iorin, you’re so popular！」

name: Iori
message: 「G-guys, this is bad...！ If someone sees us like this...！」
Asahi I could understand, but even Setsugekka and Momiji...！

name: Iori
message: 「Can’t be helped, if it’s come to this... One, two...！！」
I lift everyone up and haul them off to somewhere out of sight.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa~, Sensei, you’re amazing♪」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, we’re heading straight to the bedroom, aren't we.」

name: Iori
message: 「Don’t say such ominous things！」
Even though I say that, it’s actually pretty fun. Before I knew it, I was laughing along with them.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Setsugekka-san, you really ate a lot. To polish off that much dessert just like that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wahahaha, I’m the <d0098>Glutton Champion</d>♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Seriously, that was wild！ You’re the first person besides me I’ve ever seen finish three giant crepes！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, you’re no one to talk, you know？ Watch your stomach, okay？」
After taking a snack break, we all wander off together.
We turn the corner and come out in front of an apparel shop—or so I thought, and then Ririmu’s energy levels skyrocket.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah！ This brand opened up a store here~！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Now that I think about it... your casual clothes now aren't bad, but let's try getting something even more stylish！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh~！？ I pick out my own clothes, so I’m fine.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don’t say that. Secchan... here, take this！ I think this would look super good on you.」
Ririmu effortlessly tosses over the clothes she picked in an instant. Hey, wait, just like that—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, what’s this！？ It’s actually really cute！」
—It... it actually suits her！？

name: Ririmu
message: 「Fufun, don’t underestimate my aesthetic sense. I’ve got everyone’s worldviews perfectly figured out.」

name: Asahi
message: 「That sounds interesting. Ririmu-san, what kind of clothes do you think would suit me？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, what, Asahi-chan is going to...！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「<d0099>murmur</d>, murmur...」
In front of everyone's surprised eyes, Ririmu looks Asahi over from top to bottom.
Her gaze is terrifyingly serious. Oh, she’s entered designer mode, huh. Ririmu.

name: Asahi
message: 「Being observed so closely... it's a little embarrassing.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, for Asahi... Okay, decided！ Just wait a sec.」
No sooner said than done, Ririmu darted into the store.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Isn't she more serious about this than she is about class？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, is it alright if I go somewhere else？」
Standing in front of a women's clothing store for this long is just plain uncomfortable.

name: Momiji
message: 「Once you get married, this sort of thing happens all the time, so you'd better just think of it as training and do your best.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh, okay...」
I’d been lectured by Momiji.
While all that was going on, Ririmu came back.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Found it, found it！ It was tough, but I found the perfect one！ Here, Asahi, this is for you！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Is this... a dress? How mysterious... It's just black and white patterns, but the impression it gives changes completely from the front to the back.」
A dress colored in separate black and white sections.
I was startled at first, thinking it looked like a cow... but that’s not quite it. When held up against her body, it gives off an entirely different impression.

name: Momiji
message: 「I see, simple is best, right?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Woooow！ How could you tell？ Could it be that Ririmu-chan is a genius！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I just knew it would suit her, that's all. Besides, we're not done yet, okay？ If you're going to carry a bag, use this one and this one. And for the hair accessory, do it like this...」
She shows off her sense one after another, like a fashion show. Asahi, the model, is wide-eyed and bewildered.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You look like a different person！ Bravo, absolutely wonderful~♪」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm surprised... but, I think it suits you very well, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Really？ I... I'm so happy...」
Asahi shows a shy smile. It seems everyone is convinced by Ririmu’s impeccable sense.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yep, yep, I'd say it's perfect, just like I imagined！ Asahi, you look super cool♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, hey, why did you choose this black and white dress？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Look, Asahi, you've got a crazy foul mouth, right？ So I tried expressing pure innocence and a two-faced side in a girly style.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You chose my clothes for a reason like that...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, I'm not dissing you, okay？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Clothes are all about expressing a person's aesthetic, after all. I feel like there's no point if you don't play up their individuality and signature traits~」

name: Momiji
message: 「So Asahi's signature trait is being two-faced, huh? Yep, makes total sense.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahahahaha! A two-faced outfit—that's hilarious!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Mmm, as long as I don't think about the reason, it really is a lovely outfit, but... I have mixed feelings about this.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's fine as long as you like it, isn't it? We've got Ririmu's fashion sense to thank for that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...You're right. The outfit Ririmu-san picked out for me—I don't think it's bad at all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「All right~! While I'm on a roll, I'm gonna pick out Momimomi's outfit too~!」
And so, with Ririmu on an unstoppable roll, the girls' dress-up extravaganza began.
